jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: We re the world s leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada. We re driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support. You ll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women s and men s health conditions. We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries. We re looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally. We hope that s you. About the Role As a Staff Data Engineer, you will take responsibility for our most complex data platform work, owning the ingestion pipelines, streaming infrastructure and platform capabilities that Analytics Engineering, Data Science and business teams rely on every day. Based in our London HQ, you will support the Hims US business as part of the wider Hims & Hers data community, working closely with data teams on both sides of the Atlantic. Working across data engineering, platform engineering and analytics, you will act as the directly responsible owner for multi-sprint initiatives, including CDC connector buildouts, our BigQuery warehouse workstreams and event-streaming infrastructure. You will also mentor Senior Data Engineers, helping them grow from squad-level to cross-squad impact, and help raise the engineering standards of the whole team as we scale our preventative care ecosystem globally. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. En tant que stagiaire Data Analyst, tu seras intégré(e) à une équipe travaillant étroitement avec des consultants / data scientists et tu participeras à des missions ayant un impact réel pour les clients. Tes missions pourront inclure : Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.). Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles. Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients. Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier. Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables. Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples. jobs.description: About Us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the Team We build the AI agent that helps merchandisers, product managers, and executives grow their e-commerce business: it finds opportunities in their data, tailors insights to each person's role, and takes routine work off their plate by delivering answers where they already work. We are transforming how digital merchandising teams work: instead of digging through reports and configuring rules by hand, they ask in plain language, get answers grounded in their own data, and approve the changes the agent prepares. Customers already rely on the agent to save time and make better decisions. We own the agent end to end, from the first question a merchant asks to the answer they act on. We also own the analytics behind it: the pipelines and cubes for search, browse, and recommendation performance, and the metric definitions merchants rely on. That is why we build the agent and the Customer Dashboard as a platform that every Constructor team extends. We create the foundation that other teams build on: the agent framework, shared components, and infrastructure. On top of it, teams add their own data, tools, and skills, so the agent can answer questions in their domain and the dashboard can show their features without separate interfaces. Each new capability gives merchants more ways to grow their business. What you'll do Build and own the batch pipelines and cubes behind dashboard analytics and agent insights Model shopper, trend, and benchmark data so the agent can find opportunities across the shopping journey Shape data for each role: a merchandiser's category, a product manager's funnel step, an executive's total Own data quality and trust: freshness, monitoring, alerting, and metric definitions Work with enginee

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers.
